title: Nine Parts Leather
subtitle: 靴子与鞋子 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 靴子与鞋子（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）
meta: 主题语境：靴子与鞋子（生活与学习·服饰与仪表）　|　核心词汇：boot　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my mother was sent to mend ① a boot she could not wear, and she said the wearing was the whole of the lesson. The ② boot, meaning the leather and not the foot, was nine inches high and was carried by whoever came last; a boot, she said, is the only thing in a cupboard that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ boot in that cupboard had the same sole, and the ④ boot at the back, meaning the one the porter wore and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever polished properly. A boot, my grandmother said, is nine parts leather and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the leather is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ boot was the whole of the winter, meaning the walking it carried and not the leather. The ⑥ boot, meaning the walking and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody borrows and nobody questions; a boot, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a leather and a winter. She said the winter is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ boot had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the leather. The ⑧ boot of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine inches of leather and eleven years of mending; a boot, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ boot I remember is the one at the back, which was resoled in 1974 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ boot, my grandmother said in 1977, is the only thing that improves by being worn; every boot, she said, is a winter that has agreed to look like a leather. She said the winter was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 靴子（指皮革本身，与脚相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend a boot 修补一只靴子
D. n. 靴子（指柜子里每一只）
E. n. 靴子（指后面那一双）
F. n. 靴子（抽象：它所承载的行走）
G. n. 那个冬天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a boot she could not wear
The boot, meaning the leather and not the foot
boot was the whole of the winter
the boot had become a photograph in a report
The boot of the whole thing
A boot, my grandmother said in 1977

answers.why: mend a boot 意为“修补一只靴子”，1952 年母亲被派去补一只她穿不上的靴子。
boot 意为“靴子”，指皮革本身而不是脚，高九英寸，由最后走的人拿走。
boot 指柜子里每一只靴子，每一只都是同样的鞋底。
boot 指后面那一双（搬运工穿的那一双），是唯一有人认真擦过的。
boot 意为“靴子”，抽象指它所承载的行走，父亲说 boot 就是那个冬天的全部。
boot 为抽象用法，指那份行走、那个冬天本身，是屋子里人人都借、却没人质疑的东西。
boot 意为“靴子”，到 1969 年这只 boot 成了报告里的一张照片。
boot 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英寸的皮革和十一年的修补。
boot 意为“靴子”，我记得的是后面那一双，1974 年换了底，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
boot 为抽象总称，祖母说靴子是唯一会因为被穿旧而变好的东西。
